description: Bitcoin network and node state: difficulty, network hashrate, total transactions processed and the current tx/s rate, protocol version, peer connections, relay fee, mempool size, uptime and which indexes (txindex) are synced on our node. When to use: macro questions about Bitcoin - how much hashrate secures it, how fast the chain is moving, or whether our node's indexes are complete. Do not use: for fees (btc_get_fee_rates) or mempool depth (btc_get_mempool_state). Returns: difficulty, network_hashrate_hs, chain_tx_count_total, tx_rate_per_s, client, connections, relay_fee_btc_kvb, uptime_s, indexes{}.
name: btc_get_network_stats
